raw_text: Eritrean troops remain in Ethiopia's Tigray region months after a ceasefire deal was signed, according to satellite images analyzed by researchers and accounts from residents and aid workers. The continued presence undermines the November peace agreement brokered in Pretoria. Ethiopian government officials have not responded to requests for comment. The African Union has called for full implementation of the agreement.
clean_text: Reuters reports Eritrean troops remain in Tigray months after ceasefire. Satellite images and resident accounts confirm presence. AU calls for full implementation of Pretoria agreement.
